name: ai-council-run-guard
description: Bound long Codex and council runs with deterministic budgets, stuck detection, and handoffs.

interface.shortDescription: Stop costly, circular agent runs cleanly.
interface.longDescription: Applies repository-owned time, review, agent, qualification, and stuck-loop limits, then writes a durable checkpoint or NOT READY handoff.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the repository bounded-run contract and report the remaining budget before starting.
